title: The bench, empty
logline: The seawall bench in April with nobody on it and no dog under it, the crow on the wall, the bay. The page the sequence exists to draw: the strip's place with the strip gone.

panels.composition: A seawall bench empty in April light with nothing beneath it, a crow on the wall behind, a gray bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an empty seawall bench in April light with nothing beneath it, a crow on the wall behind and a gray bay, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The strip's place with the strip gone.
